description: Audit one strategy's return series in one call: deflated Sharpe, the minimum track record length for its Sharpe to beat the benchmark, and, with every variant's returns, the probability of backtest overfitting. Point returns_file at the backtest's CSV or JSON rather than copying long series into the call. Each check is the matching validate_ tool's result with its own receipt, side by side; the audit does not grade the strategy. Uses one validation per check. A deflated Sharpe or overfitting probability above or below any threshold is not admission to anything and is not a forecast.

cross_trial_sharpe_sd_annualized.description: Standard deviation of the annualized Sharpe across those trials.

effective_independent_trials.description: Independent variants tried before choosing this one.

n_splits.description: Even number of blocks, at least 2; default 16.

periods_per_year.description: Observations per year: 252 daily, 365 daily crypto, 52 weekly, 12 monthly.

returns.description: Periodic returns as fractions (0.01 is 1%), oldest first; replaces the Sharpe, observations, skew and kurtosis fields.

returns_column.description: Header name or 1-based position of the returns column when returns_file has several numeric columns.

returns_file.description: Path to a CSV or JSON file of the returns on the machine running this server, instead of returns. Not available on the hosted endpoint.

variants.description: Optional returns of every variant tried, this one included, as fractions: one row per period, one column per variant. Adds the overfitting check.

variants_file.description: Path to a CSV or JSON file of every variant's returns (one numeric column per variant), instead of variants.

name: audit_backtest
title: Audit a backtest
